disciplinary_grounds.description: Deceit or material misrepresentation in procuring or attempting to procure a license or certification
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of deceit or material misrepresentation in procuring or attempting to procure: a license to practice registered nursing, licensed practical nursing, or a license to practice advanced practice registered nursing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or any offense substantially related to the qualifications, functions, or duties of a licensee, or any offense involving fraud, dishonesty, or violence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of a felony, or any offense substantially related to the qualifications, functions or duties of any licensee or Advanced Unlicensed Assistant, or any offense an essential element of which is fraud, dishonesty, or an act of violence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to adequately care for patients or conform to minimum standards of acceptable nursing practice, unnecessarily exposing patients to risk of harm
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to adequately care for patients or to conform to the minimum standards of acceptable nursing or Advanced Unlicensed Assistant practice that, in the opinion of the Board, unnecessarily exposes a patient or other person to risk of harm

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intemperate use of alcohol or drugs that endangers or could endanger patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is intemperate in the use of alcohol or drugs, which use the Board determines endangers or could endanger patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pattern of practice or behavior showing actual or potential inability to practice nursing safely due to impairment from illness, substance use, mental or physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Exhibits through a pattern of practice or other behavior actual or potential inability to practice nursing with sufficient knowledge or reasonable skills and safety due to impairment caused by illness, use of alcohol, drugs, chemicals or any other substance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adjudicated as mentally incompetent, mentally ill, chemically dependent, or dangerous to the public, or committed by a court
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been adjudicated as mentally incompetent, mentally ill, chemically dependent or dangerous to the public or has been committed by a court of competent jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of unprofessional conduct as defined in the rules of the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of unprofessional conduct as defined in the rules of the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any act that jeopardizes a patient's life, health, or safety as defined in the rules of the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of any act that jeopardizes a patient's life, health or safety as defined in the rules of the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of a Board rule, Board order, or state/federal law relating to nursing practice or narcotics/controlled dangerous substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated a rule promulgated by the Board, an order of the Board, or a state or federal law relating to the practice of registered, practical or advanced practice registered nursing or advanced unlicensed assisting, or a state or federal narcotics or controlled dangerous substance law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary actions taken against the individual's nursing license or any professional/occupational license in this or any other state, territory, or country
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had disciplinary actions taken against the individual's registered or practical nursing license, advanced unlicensed assistive certification, or any professional or occupational license, registration or certification in this or any state, territory or country

disciplinary_grounds.description: Default or termination from the peer assistance program for any reason
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has defaulted or been terminated from the peer assistance program for any reason

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain professional boundaries with patients as defined in Board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to maintain professional boundaries with patients, as defined in the Board rules

disciplinary_grounds.description: Sexual misconduct with a current or former patient or key party, inside or outside the health care setting
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engages in sexual misconduct, as defined in Board rules, with a current or former patient or key party, inside or outside the health care setting

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly providing gender transition procedures to a child
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has knowingly provided gender transition procedures as defined in Section 1 of this act to a child

definition_quote.value: The practice of nursing means the performance of services provided for purposes of nursing diagnosis and treatment of human responses to actual or potential health problems consistent with educational preparation.
definition_quote.quote: "The practice of nursing" means the performance of services provided for purposes of nursing diagnosis and treatment of human responses to actual or potential health problems consistent with educational preparation.

methods_authorized.quote: "Registered nursing" means the practice of the full scope of nursing which includes, but is not limited to: assessing the health status of individuals, families, and groups, analyzing assessment data to determine nursing care needs, establishing goals to meet identified health care needs, planning a strategy of care

drug_authority.value: APRNs (CNP, CNS, CNM) may obtain prescriptive authority through the Board; CRNAs may order, select, obtain, and administer legend drugs and Schedules II-V controlled substances during perioperative/periobstetrical period in collaboration with a physician.
drug_authority.quote: A Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist, in collaboration with a medical doctor, osteopathic physician, podiatric physician, or dentist licensed in this state, and under conditions in which timely, on-site consultation by such medical doctor, osteopathic physician, podiatric physician, or dentist is available, shall be authorized, pursuant to rules adopted by the Oklahoma Board of Nursing, to order, select, obtain, and administer legend drugs, Schedules II through V controlled substances, devices, and medical gases only when engaged in the preanesthetic preparation and evaluation; anesthesia induction, maintenance, and emergence; and postanesthesia care.
